description: The operations hkdfguard-integration-hashicorpvault generates from openapi.json: logging in and managing tokens, the KV and cubbyhole secrets engines, the transit engine (HkdfGuard's KMS), and a few system endpoints. Each entry is a regular expression matched against an operation's name in PascalCase, as .NET names it (KvV2Read for kv_v2_read), and must match at least one. Anything else stays reachable through VaultClient's generic read, write, list and delete. Regenerate after changing this: uv run python scripts/generate-vault-client.py (from hkdfguard-python)
